title: Hotness
content:
In case you haven’t heard, it’s quite hot in Los Angeles, but that’s October in LA for you. I went to the farmers market, as I do nearly every Sunday and even at 9am it was insanely hot. I’m sitting in my car in Santa Monica at the moment and it says it’s 101 degrees. My watch say 95, so it’s probably somewhere in the middle.

I distinctly remember going to pumpkin patches in October when the kids were younger and it was always dreadfully hot.

And if the heat weren’t enough, the mosquitoes are completely out of control. I picked up buckets at home depot so I can build some mosquito traps for around our house. A neighbor I was talking to yesterday did the same.
